methodologyNotes: Roster covers twelve current-market indoor air quality monitors. Specs and prices were independently re-verified (2026-06-20) against official manufacturer pages (airthings.com, getawair.com, iqair.com/us, aranet.com, getuhoo.com, evehome.com, www2.purpleair.com, temtopus.com) and topical retailers/reviews (Amazon, Walmart, airdetectortools.com, breathesafeair.com, techhive.com, housefresh.com). Booleans under specKeys indicate confirmed presence (true) or confirmed absence (false); null means presence could not be confirmed. priceUsd reflects the published US list/MSRP for the exact named model at time of access; promotional/sale or street pricing is noted in priceNote. Where the exact named draft source URL 404'd, it was replaced with a working, topical URL and noted in provenance. accessedAt 2026-06-20 throughout.

products.name: Airthings View Plus
products.priceNote: MSRP, single unit; frequently discounted (~$235-265 promos seen)

specs.power: 6 AA batteries (up to 2 yr) or USB-C

products.provenance: Official Airthings page confirms 7 sensors (radon, PM2.5, CO2, VOC, temp, humidity, pressure) and customizable ePaper display. MSRP $299 corroborated by breathesafeair.com (review titled 'Worth $300?') and Airthings newsroom, which dates the launch to March 11, 2021. Model 2960. Verified 2026-06-20.

products.name: Airthings Wave Plus
products.priceNote: Airthings/Amazon list price $229; Sylvane authorized retailer lists $249.99 (often backordered)

specs.display_screen: LED glow ring (red/yellow/green), no numeric screen

products.provenance: Official Airthings page confirms 6 sensors: radon, CO2, TVOC, temp, humidity, air pressure; no PM2.5. Red/yellow/green LED glow ring, no numeric display. Price corrected 249.99 -> 229: $229 is the prevailing Airthings/Amazon list price; Sylvane lists $249.99. 2019 TIME Best Inventions; product line dates to 2018. Model 2930. Verified 2026-06-20.

products.name: Awair Element
products.priceNote: Current official store (getawair.com) US list $299; original 2019 launch MSRP was $149 and Amazon street is ~$199

specs.display_screen: LED dot-matrix display (5-dot AQI score + numeric readout)
specs.power: AC plug-in (100-240 V, 5 V/2 A adapter)

products.provenance: Official Awair page confirms sensors PM2.5, CO2, VOC, temp, humidity; no radon; AC plug-in only; on-device display. Source URL corrected from /pages/element-iaq-air (non-canonical) to /products/element (live, shows $299 US / GBP 229 / EUR 259). NOTE on price: the Element launched at $149 MSRP in Nov 2019 (TechHive, Gearbrain) and sells ~$199 on Amazon; the current official-store list is $299, retained as priceUsd. Verified 2026-06-20.

products.name: Temtop M10
products.priceNote: No published US price confirmable from a working manufacturer page; retail listings (Amazon/Walmart/eBay) seen around $59-70 but inconsistent, so left null

specs.power: 2200 mAh rechargeable battery (~6 hr runtime), charges via USB

products.provenance: Base M10 measures PM2.5, HCHO (formaldehyde), TVOC/AQI; NO CO2 (that is the M10+); no app connectivity. Source URL corrected: the draft's temtopus.com slug returns HTTP 404; replaced with the live Amazon listing (ASIN B0BPB1G387) and Walmart corroboration. Price corrected 59.99 -> null: could not confirm the exact $59.99 published US price from any working manufacturer/retailer page (signals ranged ~$59-70). Release year not published. A null beats a guess. Verified 2026-06-20.

products.name: Temtop M10+

specs.power: 2200 mAh rechargeable battery (~60 days claimed), charges via USB-C

products.provenance: Official temtopus.com page (live) confirms 6-in-1: CO2 + PM2.5 + VOC + temp + humidity (Sensirion sensors), Bluetooth/Wi-Fi app connectivity, e-ink display, and current sale price $129.99 (list $169.99). No radon. Release year not published. All draft fields verified 2026-06-20.

products.name: Temtop P1000

specs.power: Rechargeable Li-ion battery (~6 hr), also wall-mountable with USB power

products.provenance: Sensors confirmed: PM2.5, PM10, CO2, temp, humidity; no VOC, no radon; 7.3-in LCD; no app connectivity. Source URL corrected: draft's elitechus.com slug returns HTTP 404; replaced with live Amazon listing (ASIN B07DHZ3MFR), corroborated by US retailer airdetectortools.com. Price corrected null -> 129.99: a published US price IS available (airdetectortools $129.99 sale / $149.99 list), so null was unnecessarily conservative. Release year not published. products.name: Amazon Smart Air Quality Monitor

specs.display_screen: No screen - LED color indicator only

products.provenance: Sensors confirmed: PM2.5, CO (carbon monoxide), VOC, temp, humidity (Sensirion SEN44 + Figaro TGS5141). No CO2, no radon. No display - LED color indicator only; Micro-USB powered. MSRP $69.99 confirmed via TechHive review and listing history. Announced Nov 2021, shipped Jan 2022. Verified 2026-06-20.

products.name: IQAir AirVisual Pro

specs.power: 5 V USB plug-in (included); internal Li-ion battery (up to 4 hr)

products.provenance: IQAir US product page (URL corrected to add /us/; draft path 404'd / non-US) confirms price $329.99, sensors PM2.5 (laser particle counter) + CO2 (NDIR), 5-inch color LCD, USB + internal Li-ion battery up to 4 hr. No VOC, no radon. Originally AirVisual Node (2016), rebranded AirVisual Pro 2018. Verified 2026-06-20.

products.name: PurpleAir Touch
products.priceNote: MSRP per purpleair.com; power adapter sold separately

specs.display_screen: No screen - full-color LED ring (AQI color scale)
specs.power: USB Micro plug-in, 5 V (adapter not included)

products.provenance: Official PurpleAir page confirms price $209, PM2.5 (Plantower PMS-1003), Bosch BME688 pressure/temp/humidity/gas sensor (provides experimental VOC reading), and full-color LED ring (no display screen). Power adapter NOT included. No CO2, no radon. Indoor-only; released 2023. Verified 2026-06-20.

products.name: uHoo Smart Air Monitor
products.priceNote: Official getuhoo.com store $299; some retailers (allergystore.com) list higher (~$354.99/$389)

specs.display_screen: No screen - single RGB LED indicator

products.provenance: Official uHoo page confirms 9 sensors (CO2, PM2.5, VOC, CO, NO2, ozone, temp, humidity, pressure), single RGB LED (no screen), plug-in power, and price $299. No radon. TechHive review corroborates 9 sensors and plug-in power. uHoo crowdfunded 2016, shipped to consumers June 2017 (release year 2017). Verified 2026-06-20.

products.name: Aranet4 Home
products.priceNote: Current street price; original MSRP was ~$249

specs.power: 2 AA batteries (up to 4-7 yr depending on battery type)

products.provenance: Official Aranet page confirms CO2 (NDIR), temp, humidity, pressure; no PM2.5/VOC/radon; e-ink display; battery-only (2 AA, up to 4 yr alkaline / 7 yr lithium); Bluetooth app. breathesafeair and HouseFresh confirm street price dropped to ~$189 from ~$249 original. Verified 2026-06-20.

products.name: Eve Room
products.priceNote: MSRP per evehome.com; frequently on sale (~$70-80)

specs.power: Rechargeable internal battery via Micro-USB (~6 weeks per charge)
